evidence.text:
Reason for referral: Evaluation of perioperative cardiac risk before planned non-cardiac
surgery.

12-lead ECG on admission: sinus rhythm with occasional premature atrial complexes at 69
bpm, PR interval 169 ms, QRS 90 ms, QTc 418 ms. Sinus rhythm with occasional premature
atrial complexes and no acute changes.

BASIC METABOLIC PANEL
Sodium: 134 mmol/L (L)
Potassium: 3.8 mmol/L
Chloride: 104 mmol/L
CO2: 24 mmol/L
BUN: 15 mg/dL
Creatinine: 1.5 mg/dL (H)
Glucose: 117 mg/dL (H)
Calcium: 8.6 mg/dL

EXAM:
General: alert, no acute distress.
Neck: no jugular venous distension.
Cardiac exam: regular rate and rhythm, normal S1 and S2, no murmurs or gallops.
Lungs: faint bibasilar crackles.
Extremities: trace ankle edema.

EXAM:
General:well appearing, no distress.
Neck: no carotid bruits.
Cardiac exam: regular rate and rhythm, normal S1 and S2, grade 2/6 systolic ejection
murmur, no radiation.
Lungs: clear to auscultation bilaterally.
Extremities: trace ankle edema.

EXAM:
General: well appearing, no distress.
Neck: no jugular venous distension.
Cardiac exam: regular rate and rhythm, normal S1 and S2, soft systolic murmur at the
sternal border, no gallop.
Lungs: faint bibasilar crackles.
Extremities: trace ankle edema.
